reviews.text: The entire team at Planet Veterinarians is fantastic; they operated on our kitten Orhi. They are great professionals, and even better people. I highly recommend them! Your pets will be in very good hands with them.

I received prompt attention after contacting them. My dog ​​needed orthopedic care. They explained everything very well, and the service was excellent. I left with all my worries resolved.
Highly recommended if you're looking for a specialist, in my case, an orthopedic surgeon.
Thank you so much, Gabriel, for your prompt attention.

We can only express our gratitude to the entire team of amazing professionals at Planet Veterinarians, especially Gabi, who knew what was wrong with our dog the moment she saw him and, after some tests, was able to fix it with surgery. He's doing wonderfully now, and seeing him like this after everything he's been through is priceless.

Thanks also to Andrea, Sara, and the rest of the team for their kindness, for explaining everything so well, and for always answering our questions. We don't know what would have become of him without you. Thank you!

It was truly a great discovery.

We came to them after seeing other veterinarians without finding a solution.

I can say they are the best veterinarians in Valencia.

At home, we have four cats. Three of them are female and allergic. The one who isn't allergic, a cat named Suertudo, got very sick and vomited constantly. He was like that for three weeks, and no veterinarian could offer us a solution.

Initially, emergency surgery was considered, but first, they performed several tests, including an ultrasound.

At Veterinarios Planet, they gave him a specific treatment, and two months ago, my cat was perfectly fine and avoided surgery.

They are still monitoring him, and if things get complicated at any point, we will return to the surgery option with Dr. Gabriel Carbonel.

I love the quality of their care and their professional dedication.

In the case of my son's cat, they operated on him for cancer, and fortunately, everything went well.

100% recommended.

Without a doubt, the best veterinarians in Valencia.

My cat is so lucky to have them as his vets.

⭐Excellent clinic for quality/price⭐
I have several pets and have been to many veterinarians, even hospitals... But I'm sticking with your service!
You helped me amputate my cat Lilith's leg and improve her quality of life. She's recovering very quickly! 👏🏻🩹❤️‍🩹
The team's prompt attention and dedication are excellent. The service is incredible, and your professionalism is outstanding.
I don't have enough stars to rate you enough; thank you so much for your work! ❤️‍🩹💯

My dog ​​had an accident and fractured her femur, a very serious break. Our clinic recommended Dr. Gabriel, and he was able to operate on her that same night.

It was a complicated recovery, but Dr. Gabriel monitored her every step of the way. A little over a year later, she's running and using all four paws again as if (almost) nothing had happened. We are so grateful that everything turned out well.

Our trusted veterinarian referred us for a procedure for our kitten, and we've been delighted. From the moment you walk in the door, they're incredibly kind, have a deep love for animals, are very caring, empathetic, and professional. They email or call you every day to check on your pet's condition and how they're doing after the surgery. Highly recommended.

I can't thank you enough for what you've done for Kinder. Seriously, the surgery you performed saved his life. It's so wonderful to see him healthy again and eager to play.

Thank you so much for everything; you're the best! 🙂

I wanted to leave this review because I'm truly grateful to this clinic. ❤️ I came here after taking my puppy to another vet, where I didn't feel completely at ease or confident with the care. Looking for a second option, we found this clinic, and from the very first moment, the feeling was completely different.

They instilled so much more confidence and security in me, which was crucial, especially since my little one needed surgery and I was quite worried. Dr. Gabriel was incredibly kind, approachable, and attentive, and the staff there were lovely. They treated my puppy with so much love and care at all times, and as an owner, that's something I'm so grateful for. 🐶❤️ They also resolved everything very quickly and were very attentive to us. I felt that they were truly looking out for my puppy and that she was in good hands, which gave me enormous peace of mind.

I'm so glad I decided to look for another clinic and ended up here. Sometimes finding the right people to care for our pets makes all the difference.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for their kindness, professionalism, and above all, for taking such good care of my little one. ❤️🐾 I would definitely choose them again and I highly recommend them.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. We went there for one of my cats, who had been diagnosed with a mast cell tumor at another clinic. Initially, that other clinic suggested amputating his tail as a preventative measure, without yet knowing if it was an aggressive tumor or not. That's why we decided to seek a second opinion and went to Planet Clinic.

Gabriel, along with his colleagues Andrea and Sara, saw us, and from the very first moment, they were incredibly attentive and caring with our cat. We also greatly appreciated the clinic's calm atmosphere, which allowed our cat to be as relaxed as possible throughout the entire process.

From the beginning, their assessment was very positive and optimistic. They explained that before making such a drastic decision as amputation, it was necessary to determine the specific type of mast cell tumor through a biopsy, thus avoiding unnecessary surgery. Ultimately, thanks to their assessment and the entire process, we were able to avoid amputation.

Another thing I would highlight is the excellent care we received throughout the entire process. They are very punctual and explain everything in detail so you have no doubts. They also closely monitor your pet's progress, both during in-clinic checkups and via text message, which is incredibly reassuring, especially after surgery.

In our case, they also provided all the medication we needed for the post-operative period, which is greatly appreciated because you leave the clinic with everything taken care of and knowing exactly what to do.

We even traveled from another city to their clinic because we had complete faith in their experience and their approach, and after everything we went through, we can say it was totally worth it. Thanks to them, our cat is still happy with his tail and, most importantly, without a tumor or any other complications.

We are very grateful for their care, professionalism, and above all, for finding the best option for him instead of resorting directly to amputation. We will definitely return to them whenever we need to.
